keyword.en: how to inquire Xingtai for LZ-80 Diesel Concrete Pump
keyword.zh: 如何向邢台询盘LZ-80柴油混凝土泵

title.en: Ask Xingtai to price the LZ-80 Diesel Concrete Pump only after the inquiry names output, distance, power and particle size
title.zh: 向邢台询LZ-80柴油混凝土泵的价格前，先写清输送量、距离、动力和粒径

description.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists the LZ-80 Diesel Concrete Pump at /products/lz-80-diesel-concrete-pump. Copy only the printed cells: Model LZ-80; Engine (Diesel) 256 kW (Yuchai); Theoretical Output High pressure ≤ 65 m³/h; low pressure ≤ 95 m³/h; Pumping Pressure High pressure ≤ 35 MPa; low pressure ≤ 22 MPa; H
description.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把LZ-80柴油混凝土泵列在 /products/lz-80-diesel-concrete-pump。只抄已印格子：型号 LZ-80; 柴油发动机 256 kW (Yuchai); 理论输送量 High pressure ≤ 65 m³/h; low pressure ≤ 95 m³/h; 泵送压力 High pressure ≤ 35 MPa; low pressure ≤ 22 MPa; 料斗容积 0.6 m³; 输送距离 120 m; 输送高度 Consult factory standard; 最大骨料粒径 6 cm and below; 液压泵 Kawasaki double 140; 外形尺寸 6.6

h1.en: The LZ-80 Diesel Concrete Pump inquiry starts from the printed page
h1.zh: LZ-80柴油混凝土泵的询盘从已印页面开始

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists the LZ-80 Diesel Concrete Pump at /products/lz-80-diesel-concrete-pump. Copy only the printed cells: Model LZ-80; Engine (Diesel) 256 kW (Yuchai); Theoretical Output High pressure ≤ 65 m³/h; low pressure ≤ 95 m³/h; Pumping Pressure High pressure ≤ 35 MPa; low pressure ≤ 22 MPa; Hopper Capacity 0.6 m³; Conveying Distance 120 m; Delivery Height Consult factory standard; Max. Aggregate Size 6 cm and below; Hydraulic Pump Kawasaki double 140; Dimensions (L×W×H) 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m; Total Weight 6800 kg. For transport, copy Dimensions (L×W×H) is 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m and Total Weight is 6800 kg. The printed output cell is High pressure ≤ 65 m³/h; low pressure ≤ 95 m³/h. Compare the pour or spray rate you need with that cell. If the job is larger, open another listed page instead of stretching this number. The printed distance row or rows: Pumping Pressure High pressure ≤ 35 MPa; low pressure ≤ 22 MPa; Conveying Distance 120 m. Name horizontal and vertical metres, and name which row you mean. A distance row is not a stone-size cell. This page does not print motor kilowatts or an engine rating. Say whether the site has grid power or diesel, and ask Xingtai. Do not guess a kilowatt number. The printed aggregate or particle cell is 6 cm and below. Send the maximum stone or particle size in the mix. If the mix is coarser, this row is the wrong page. OEM or a change starts from the listed model at /products/lz-80-diesel-concrete-pump. Send the change to Xingtai. Do not invent a model name or a performance number the page does not print. No price is printed on the product page. Confirm the price with Xingtai. The photograph on this note is a content image from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gravel. It shows: Naturally occurring sedimentary gravel bed. It is a reference picture for the inquiry topic. It is not a Hebei Pinjin Machinery nameplate, not a quotation, and not an export case.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把LZ-80柴油混凝土泵列在 /products/lz-80-diesel-concrete-pump。只抄已印格子：型号 LZ-80; 柴油发动机 256 kW (Yuchai); 理论输送量 High pressure ≤ 65 m³/h; low pressure ≤ 95 m³/h; 泵送压力 High pressure ≤ 35 MPa; low pressure ≤ 22 MPa; 料斗容积 0.6 m³; 输送距离 120 m; 输送高度 Consult factory standard; 最大骨料粒径 6 cm and below; 液压泵 Kawasaki double 140; 外形尺寸 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m; 整机重量 6800 kg。运输请抄外形尺寸是 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m，整机重量是 6800 kg。已印输送量是 High pressure ≤ 65 m³/h; low pressure ≤ 95 m³/h。把需要的浇筑或喷涂方量与这一格对照。工程更大时，打开另一条已列页面，不要把这个数字拉长。已印距离行：泵送压力 High pressure ≤ 35 MPa; low pressure ≤ 22 MPa；输送距离 120 m。询盘写明水平米数、垂直米数，并点明是哪一行。距离行不是石子粒径。这一页没有印电机千瓦或发动机额定值。说明现场是电网还是柴油，并向邢台询问。不要猜一个千瓦数。已印骨料或粒径是 6 cm and below。询盘写混合物里的最大石子或粒径。料更粗时，这一行就不是该打开的页面。OEM 或改动从已列型号 /products/lz-80-diesel-concrete-pump 开始。把要改的内容发给邢台。不要自编型号，也不要写页面没有印的性能数字。产品页没有印价格。价格向邢台询盘确认。这篇配图是 https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gravel 页面里的内容图片。画面主体：碎石。它只作询盘主题的参考。它不是河北品锦机械的铭牌，不是报价单，也不是出口案例。

body.en: Put /products/lz-80-diesel-concrete-pump in the subject. The published cells are: Model LZ-80; Engine (Diesel) 256 kW (Yuchai); Theoretical Output High pressure ≤ 65 m³/h; low pressure ≤ 95 m³/h; Pumping Pressure High pressure ≤ 35 MPa; low pressure ≤ 22 MPa; Hopper Capacity 0.6 m³; Conveying Distance 120 m; Delivery Height Consult factory standard; Max. Aggregate Size 6 cm and below; Hydraulic Pump Kawasaki double 140; Dimensions (L×W×H) 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m; Total Weight 6800 kg. Leave any cell the page does not print empty.
body.zh: 主题里写上 /products/lz-80-diesel-concrete-pump。已公布的格子是：型号 LZ-80; 柴油发动机 256 kW (Yuchai); 理论输送量 High pressure ≤ 65 m³/h; low pressure ≤ 95 m³/h; 泵送压力 High pressure ≤ 35 MPa; low pressure ≤ 22 MPa; 料斗容积 0.6 m³; 输送距离 120 m; 输送高度 Consult factory standard; 最大骨料粒径 6 cm and below; 液压泵 Kawasaki double 140; 外形尺寸 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m; 整机重量 6800 kg。页面没有印的格子保持空白。

heading.en: Output, distance, power and particle size
heading.zh: 输送量、距离、动力和粒径

body.en: The printed output cell is High pressure ≤ 65 m³/h; low pressure ≤ 95 m³/h. Compare the pour or spray rate you need with that cell. If the job is larger, open another listed page instead of stretching this number. The printed distance row or rows: Pumping Pressure High pressure ≤ 35 MPa; low pressure ≤ 22 MPa; Conveying Distance 120 m. Name horizontal and vertical metres, and name which row you mean. A distance row is not a stone-size cell. This page does not print motor kilowatts or an engine rating. Say whether the site has grid power or diesel, and ask Xingtai. Do not guess a kilowatt number. The printed aggregate or particle cell is 6 cm and below. Send the maximum stone or particle size in the mix. If the mix is coarser, this row is the wrong page.
body.zh: 已印输送量是 High pressure ≤ 65 m³/h; low pressure ≤ 95 m³/h。把需要的浇筑或喷涂方量与这一格对照。工程更大时，打开另一条已列页面，不要把这个数字拉长。已印距离行：泵送压力 High pressure ≤ 35 MPa; low pressure ≤ 22 MPa；输送距离 120 m。询盘写明水平米数、垂直米数，并点明是哪一行。距离行不是石子粒径。这一页没有印电机千瓦或发动机额定值。说明现场是电网还是柴油，并向邢台询问。不要猜一个千瓦数。已印骨料或粒径是 6 cm and below。询盘写混合物里的最大石子或粒径。料更粗时，这一行就不是该打开的页面。

heading.en: What to ask Xingtai instead of guessing
heading.zh: 该问邢台，而不是自己猜

body.en: OEM or a change starts from the listed model at /products/lz-80-diesel-concrete-pump. Send the change to Xingtai. Do not invent a model name or a performance number the page does not print. Also send country and purchase timing as facts about your order. Do not turn them into a promised lead time or an export-country list. No price is printed on the product page. Confirm the price with Xingtai.
body.zh: OEM 或改动从已列型号 /products/lz-80-diesel-concrete-pump 开始。把要改的内容发给邢台。不要自编型号，也不要写页面没有印的性能数字。同时把国家和采购时间作为订单事实发来。不要把它们写成承诺交期，也不要写成出口国名单。产品页没有印价格。价格向邢台询盘确认。

body.en: The photograph on this note is a content image from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gravel. It shows: Naturally occurring sedimentary gravel bed. It is a reference picture for the inquiry topic. It is not a Hebei Pinjin Machinery nameplate, not a quotation, and not an export case.
body.zh: 这篇配图是 https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gravel 页面里的内容图片。画面主体：碎石。它只作询盘主题的参考。它不是河北品锦机械的铭牌，不是报价单，也不是出口案例。

question.en: Is a price printed for the LZ-80 Diesel Concrete Pump?
question.zh: LZ-80柴油混凝土泵印了价格吗？

answer.en: No price is printed on the product page. Confirm the price with Xingtai.
answer.zh: 产品页没有印价格。价格向邢台询盘确认。

answer.en: Theoretical Output is High pressure ≤ 65 m³/h; low pressure ≤ 95 m³/h
answer.zh: 理论输送量是 High pressure ≤ 65 m³/h; low pressure ≤ 95 m³/h

question.en: Can OEM numbers be guessed from a similar machine?
question.zh: OEM 数字能按相似机器猜吗？

answer.en: OEM or a change starts from the listed model at /products/lz-80-diesel-concrete-pump. Send the change to Xingtai. Do not invent a model name or a performance number the page does not print.
answer.zh: OEM 或改动从已列型号 /products/lz-80-diesel-concrete-pump 开始。把要改的内容发给邢台。不要自编型号，也不要写页面没有印的性能数字。

answer.en: It shows: Naturally occurring sedimentary gravel bed. It is the content image from the source article, not a Pinjin nameplate.
answer.zh: 画面主体：碎石。它是来源文章里的内容图片，不是品锦铭牌。
